```python
import narwhals as nw
import pandas as pd

# Create a sample DataFrame
native_df = pd.DataFrame({
    "customer": ["Alice", "Bob", "Charlie", "David", "Eve"],
    "spend": [500, 1000, 1500, 800, 2000]
})

# Wrap with narwhals
df = nw.from_native(native_df, eager_only=True)

# Add tier column with conditional expression
df = df.with_columns(
    tier=nw.when(nw.col("spend") >= 1000).then("gold").otherwise("standard")
)

# Display result
print(df.to_native())
```
